_doc: Shape of every rules/<provenance>.json file (plain JSON, no YAML). scan.sh evaluates `detect`; plan.py uses `coverage`, `priority`, `components`, `traps`.
id: short id, also the file name
name: human name
coverage: full = plan.py maps components | detect-only = recognised, plan answers 'not yet covered: report only'
priority: higher wins when several provenances are detected (the primary drives the plan)

detect.content: optional regex the file content must match

detect.dep: package name in package.json / requirements / pyproject / composer / Gemfile

detect.code: regex searched in committed text files
detect.code_only: optional true: search code files only (not .env, docs, configs); comment lines are always ignored

detected_when: any strong signal, or at least `min_weak` weak signals (default 2)
components: provenance-specific mapping read by plan.py (keys documented in each file)
traps: one line each, shown in the detail report
not_covered_note: for detect-only files: what the honest answer is today
